title: Genetically Supported Inflammatory Mediators of the Atrial Fibrillation-Heart Failure Continuum
description: Reproducible analysis code, derived non-restricted tables, and figures for a cis-pQTL Mendelian randomization, dual-outcome colocalization, mediation, and target-prioritization study of inflammatory mediators in the atrial fibrillation-heart failure continuum.
